items.title: Slop or not – can you tell AI writing from human in everyday contexts?
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve been building a crowd-sourced AI detection benchmark. Two responses to the same prompt — one from a real human (pre-2022, provably pre prevalence of AI slop on the internet), one generated by AI. You pick the slop. Three wrong and you’re out. The dataset: 16K human posts from Reddit, Hacker News, and Yelp, each paired with AI generations from 6 models across two providers (Anthropic and OpenAI) at three capability tiers. Same prompt, length-matched, no adversarial coaching — just the model’s natural voice with platform context.
Every vote is logged with model, tier, source, response time, and position. Early findings from testing: Reddit posts are easy to spot (humans are too casual for AI to mimic), HN is significantly harder. I'll be releasing the full dataset on HuggingFace and I'l

items.title: OneCLI – Vault for AI Agents in Rust
items.raw_excerpt:
We built OneCLI because AI agents are being given raw API keys. And it's going about as well as you'd expect. We figured the answer isn't "don't give agents access," it's "give them access without giving them secrets." OneCLI is an open-source gateway that sits between your AI agents and the services they call. You store your real credentials once in OneCLI's encrypted vault, and give your agents placeholder keys. When an agent makes an HTTP call through the proxy, OneCLI matches the request by host/path, verifies the agent should have access, swaps the placeholder for the real credential, and forwards the request. The agent never touches the actual secret. It just uses CLI or MCP tools as normal. Try it in one line:
docker run --pull always -p 10254:10254 -p 10255:10255 -v onecli-data:/ap

excerpt_i18n.en:
The nationwide craze for "raising shrimp" is in full swing, with individuals and companies alike rushing to experience OpenClaw (commonly known as "Lobster"). Even at Tencent's headquarters, long queues have formed for installation. As these powerful "lobsters" begin deeply integrating into systems, accessing data, and even connecting to corporate intranets, an unavoidable question emerges: how to ensure the security of these "lobsters"? On March 12, it was reported that in response to the security challenges posed by OpenClaw, Tencent has launched the OpenClaw Security Toolkit, providing security safeguards for enterprises and users, allowing installers to set aside concerns and "raise shrimp" with peace of mind.

Behind the "cyber shrimp farming," an overlooked security battle is unfolding. With the explosive global growth of OpenClaw, security vulnerabilities have simultaneously surfaced. According to Declawed, a specialized security monitoring station for OpenClaw, over 230,000 OpenClaw instances worldwide are exposed to the public internet, with China also becoming a potentially high-risk region.

Unlike traditional applications, AI Agents possess advanced permissions such as executing system commands, reading and writing files, and invoking plugins. This is especially critical for industries with high-security demands, such as finance, government, and healthcare.

items.raw_excerpt: 3 月13 日，智驾方案商卓驭在深圳举办了“高悟性端到端 4.0”体验日。在这座以路况复杂著称的城市，卓驭试图通过对老城区窄路、人车混行街区的实测，验证其最新版本 OTA 在真实环境中的处理能力。 在深圳南头古城片区，极窄的城中村道路与盲区频现的十字路口，构成了智驾系统的考场。实测显示，卓驭端到端 4.0 在处理这些无法穷尽规则的场景时，表现出了明显的拟人化特征。 最典型的例子是系统对博弈的理解。在双向单车道的狭窄缝隙中，车辆能与对向来车进行空间博弈，灵巧绕开临停车辆。此外，其“端到端驱动三点式掉头”，让车辆在断头路等极端环境下，能像老司机一样自主规划路径并完成多次揉库，全程无需接管。 这种进化的核心逻辑在于彻底抛弃规则代码。 “业界许多方案中还有不少是规则代码在起作用。而端到端 4.0 是真正让数据说话。”卓驭科技产品总监蒋卓键表示。所谓“100% 端味”，意味着从感知到决策再到控制的完整链条中，以往依赖的大量人工预设规则已被拿掉，取而代之的是由海量数据训练出的 AI 大模型。 传统基于规则的系统如同一个拿着指令手册的操作员，遇到手册外的情况便会不知所措，而端到端模型则更像是一个通过大量实战学习经验的驾驶者，在面对未知场景时能做出更合理的自主决策。 端到端模型的成熟并非一蹴而就，其底层逻辑是卓驭构建的“双闭环”研发范式：数据闭环通过对真实行车数据的回收、清洗与标注，不断喂养模型；体验闭环则是验证过的模型上车后，利用量产车源源不断回传的长尾问题和场景数据，反哺模型优化。 这种纯粹的数据驱动路径，解决了智驾体验从“可用”到“好用”的关键障碍——确定性。更深层的意义在于，这种进化是在不改变硬件平台的前提下实现的。 随着高悟性端到端 4.0 的发布，卓驭也明确了该技术将率先落地红旗“司南智驾”，并于今年上半年通过 OTA 陆续推送给红旗 HS6 PHEV、天工 05 等多款车型。

On March 13, autonomous driving solution provider Zhuoyu held an "Advanced End-to-End 4.0" experience day in Shenzhen. In this city known for its complex road conditions, Zhuoyu aimed to validate the real-world performance of its latest OTA version through tests in narrow roads of old urban areas and mixed-traffic streets. In Shenzhen's Nantou Ancient City area, extremely narrow village roads and intersections with frequent blind spots served as the testing ground for the autonomous driving system. The tests revealed that Zhuoyu's End-to-End 4.0 exhibited distinct human-like characteristics when handling scenarios with inexhaustible rules.  

A prime example is the system's understanding of negotiation. In narrow two-way single-lane gaps, the vehicle could engage in spatial negotiation with oncoming traffic, skillfully maneuvering around temporarily parked vehicles. Additionally, its "end-to-end-driven three-point U-turn" enabled the vehicle to autonomously plan paths and execute multiple parking adjustments in extreme environments like dead-end roads, mimicking an experienced driver without requiring any intervention.  

The core logic behind this evolution lies in completely abandoning rule-based code. "Many industry solutions still rely heavily on rule-based code, but End-to-End 4.0 truly lets data drive decisions," said Jiang Zhuojian, Product Director at Zhuoyu Technology. The so-called "100% end-to-end" approach means that, throughout the entire chain from perception to decision-making and control, the extensive reliance on manually preset rules has been replaced by AI models trained on massive datasets.

The changes brought by AI will be far greater than those brought by the entire internet. On March 13, at Meituan's 2026 management communication meeting, CEO Wang Xing shared his views on AI development: "Mobile internet and the internet are not fundamentally different, perhaps like roses and peonies, while AI compared to the internet is like the difference between a monkey and a flower, with a much larger scale and impact."  

"The experience of 'old experts' may not be effective; the various 'strange and unusual' ideas of young people will continue to emerge. In the face of the AI wave, the only thing we can do is actively embrace it," Wang Xing stated. "AI Agent has had a greater impact on me than ChatGPT. We have experienced the shift from the internet to mobile internet, and it is certain that the changes brought by AI will be far greater than those brought by the entire internet. It is destined to create immense productivity and will inevitably bring significant changes to organizations and work models."  

Wang Xing noted that for Meituan, the digitization of the physical world will be a very important foundation for AI. "Although large models are becoming increasingly intelligent, we can imagine that even if Einstein were a secretary and asked to book a restaurant, he still wouldn’t know if that restaurant has available seats. This is not an issue of intelligence but of information."  

Public information shows that Meituan has launched multiple AI applications and self-developed large models. In 2025, Meituan announced it would increase investment in building real-world information infrastructure. Based on the national local life information infrastructure, Meituan also launched the AI search product "Ask Xiaotuan" during this year's Spring Festival.
